scenario: The ego vehicle emergency brakes on a winding mountain road when an oncoming passenger car overtakes a truck and invades the ego lane, causing a collision.

ego.behavior: The car travels forward along a winding two-lane road and performs emergency braking to avoid a head-on collision with an oncoming vehicle.

adversarials.behavior: The car crosses the center line to overtake a large truck and enters the ego vehicle's lane, resulting in a head-on or side-swipe collision.
The truck travels forward in its own lane and is being overtaken by the passenger car.

spatial_relation: On a winding two-lane mountain road, the ego vehicle travels in one lane while an oncoming truck and passenger car approach in the opposite lane; the passenger car crosses into the ego lane to overtake the truck.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario involves a sudden emergency braking event triggered by the oncoming car's lane invasion; the scenario terminates after the collision occurs and the ego vehicle comes to a complete stop.

road_side_structures.position: Red and white chevron signs are positioned on the right side of the road indicating the winding curve direction.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the camera-host vehicle from first-person dashboard view; two adversarials are the oncoming black car and red truck. 2. Chronology: initially ego approaches a curve with chevron signs; midpoint the oncoming black car overtakes the red truck and crosses into ego lane; ending the black car collides with ego, forcing emergency braking to zero speed. 3. Evidence: speed drops from 81 to 0 km/h; black car visibly crosses center line from its lane into ego lane; truck remains in its original lane throughout.
